deals.title: Card renewal offer: $75 off $150
deals.details: Patients who renew their medical card get $75 off an order of $150 or more. Third-party listings say it must be redeemed in the same month as the renewal, and that the patient must have shopped at Ayr before.

deals.title: Compassionate care discount: 15% off
deals.details: Patients on SSDI and government assistance programs get 15% off every order. Documentation of eligibility is likely required.

deals.title: New patient discount on first three visits

deals.title: Senior discount (55+)
deals.details: Patients aged 55 and older get a discount on any physician-recommended product, and it can't be combined with other discounts. The percentage differs by source (15% on one site, 25% on others), so confirm with Ayr.

deals.title: Veteran and first responder discount: 25% off

It also lists bonus points for monthly spend or visit thresholds, plus perks such as BOGO deal days and early access to new products.
